_sources: provisions: 1961 s.234C / 2025 s.425 (coverage MODELLED by INT-DEFERMENT); the relief for capital gains and dividends arising after a date, s.425(4) / s.234C first proviso, is computed (W-112a, D-660); sources/2026-11-06-advance-tax-interest.md; D-446
summary: Interest on each instalment paid short of its share of the tax due on the return, unless enough was paid by the early dates; none on the tax of gains or dividends that arose after a date and were paid for later in the year.

routes.name: Interest for deferring advance tax
routes.description: Charged once at each instalment date on what fell short.
